scientific_integrity: A uniform integral chain argument proves the structural claim. Finite signed boundary checks through eight ground labels are corroborating tests only; no external independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The nonequivariant wedge-of-spheres homotopy type is known from Barmak (2010). The additional integral symmetric-group lattice, octahedral generators and five-term relations are the focus. No classification of all minimum-support cycles or equivariant homotopy equivalence is claimed; unindexed equivalent derivations remain possible.
title: An integral symmetric-group lattice generated by minimal octahedra in two-subset Kneser independence complexes
